_comment: Image generation settings for Trotro Rush. The API key is NEVER stored here — see README.md.
_reserve_comment: Kept back for fixes/retries. Only jobs with priority 1 may dip into it.

pricing_per_million_tokens._source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2.5-flare (2026-09-30): image input $8, output $30. Text input rate not listed, so input is conservatively billed at the image rate.

_estimate_comment: OpenAI publishes no per-image price for GPT Image 2.5, so before any real call has been made each image is assumed to cost this much (about 3-5x third-party estimates of ~$0.005-0.006 for low quality). After real calls, estimates use 1.3x the highest actual cost seen for the same size and mode.
